build.description: Configuration options for building the service's image.

oneOf.description: Path to the build context. Can be a relative path or a URL.

context.description: Path to the build context. Can be a relative path or a URL.

dockerfile.description: Name of the Dockerfile to use for building the image.

dockerfile_inline.description: Inline Dockerfile content to use instead of a Dockerfile from the build context.

entitlements.description: List of extra privileged entitlements to grant to the build process.

args.description: Build-time variables, specified as a map or a list of KEY=VAL pairs.

ssh.description: SSH agent socket or keys to expose to the build. Format is either a string or a list of 'default|<id>[=<socket>|<key>[,<key>]]'.

labels.description: Labels to apply to the built image.

cache_from.description: List of sources the image builder should use for cache resolution

cache_to.description: Cache destinations for the build cache.

no_cache.description: Do not use cache when building the image.

additional_contexts.description: Additional build contexts to use, specified as a map of name to context path or URL.

network.description: Network mode to use for the build. Options include 'default', 'none', 'host', or a network name.

pull.description: Always attempt to pull a newer version of the image.

target.description: Build stage to target in a multi-stage Dockerfile.

shm_size.description: Size of /dev/shm for the build container. A string value can use suffix like '2g' for 2 gigabytes.

extra_hosts.description: Add hostname mappings for the build container.

isolation.description: Container isolation technology to use for the build process.

privileged.description: Give extended privileges to the build container.

secrets.description: Secrets to expose to the build. These are accessible at build-time.

tags.description: Additional tags to apply to the built image.

ulimits.description: Override the default ulimits for the build container.

platforms.description: Platforms to build for, e.g., 'linux/amd64', 'linux/arm64', or 'windows/amd64'.

blkio_config.description: Block IO configuration for the service.

device_read_bps.description: Limit read rate (bytes per second) from a device.

device_read_iops.description: Limit read rate (IO per second) from a device.

device_write_bps.description: Limit write rate (bytes per second) to a device.

device_write_iops.description: Limit write rate (IO per second) to a device.

weight.description: Block IO weight (relative weight) for the service, between 10 and 1000.

weight_device.description: Block IO weight (relative weight) for specific devices.

cap_add.description: Add Linux capabilities. For example, 'CAP_SYS_ADMIN', 'SYS_ADMIN', or 'NET_ADMIN'.

cap_drop.description: Drop Linux capabilities. For example, 'CAP_SYS_ADMIN', 'SYS_ADMIN', or 'NET_ADMIN'.

cgroup.description: Specify the cgroup namespace to join. Use 'host' to use the host's cgroup namespace, or 'private' to use a private cgroup namespace.

cgroup_parent.description: Specify an optional parent cgroup for the container.

command.description: Override the default command declared by the container image, for example 'CMD' in Dockerfile.

configs.description: Grant access to Configs on a per-service basis.

container_name.description: Specify a custom container name, rather than a generated default name.

cpu_percent.description: Percentage of CPU resources to use.

cpu_shares.description: CPU shares (relative weight) for the container.

cpu_quota.description: Limit the CPU CFS (Completely Fair Scheduler) quota.

cpu_period.description: Limit the CPU CFS (Completely Fair Scheduler) period.

cpu_rt_period.description: Limit the CPU real-time period in microseconds or a duration.

cpu_rt_runtime.description: Limit the CPU real-time runtime in microseconds or a duration.

cpus.description: Number of CPUs to use. A floating-point value is supported to request partial CPUs.

cpuset.description: CPUs in which to allow execution (0-3, 0,1).

credential_spec.description: Configure the credential spec for managed service account.

config.description: The name of the credential spec Config to use.

file.description: Path to a credential spec file.

registry.description: Path to a credential spec in the Windows registry.

restart.description: Whether to restart dependent services when this service is restarted.

required.description: Whether the dependency is required for the dependent service to start.

condition.description: Condition to wait for. 'service_started' waits until the service has started, 'service_healthy' waits until the service is healthy (as defined by its healthcheck), 'service_completed_successfully' waits until the service has completed successfully.

depends_on.description: Express dependency between services. Service dependencies cause services to be started in dependency order. The dependent service will wait for the dependency to be ready before starting.

device_cgroup_rules.description: Add rules to the cgroup allowed devices list.

devices.description: List of device mappings for the container.

source.description: Path on the host to the device.

target.description: Path in the container where the device will be mapped.

dns.description: Custom DNS servers to set for the service container.

dns_opt.description: Custom DNS options to be passed to the container's DNS resolver.

dns_search.description: Custom DNS search domains to set on the service container.

domainname.description: Custom domain name to use for the service container.

entrypoint.description: Override the default entrypoint declared by the container image, for example 'ENTRYPOINT' in Dockerfile.

env_file.description: Add environment variables from a file or multiple files. Can be a single file path or a list of file paths.

label_file.description: Add metadata to containers using files containing Docker labels.

environment.description: Add environment variables. You can use either an array or a list of KEY=VAL pairs.

expose.description: Expose ports without publishing them to the host machine - they'll only be accessible to linked services.

service.description: The name of the service to extend.

file.description: The file path where the service to extend is defined.

extends.description: Extend another service, in the current file or another file.

provider.description: Specify a service which will not be manage by Compose directly, and delegate its management to an external provider.

type.description: External component used by Compose to manage setup and teardown lifecycle of the service.

external_links.description: Link to services started outside this Compose application. Specify services as <service_name>:<alias>.

extra_hosts.description: Add hostname mappings to the container network interface configuration.

gpus.description: Define GPU devices to use. Can be set to 'all' to use all GPUs, or a list of specific GPU devices.

group_add.description: Add additional groups which user inside the container should be member of.

healthcheck.description: Configure a health check for the container to monitor its health status.

hostname.description: Define a custom hostname for the service container.

image.description: Specify the image to start the container from. Can be a repository/tag, a digest, or a local image ID.

init.description: Run as an init process inside the container that forwards signals and reaps processes.

ipc.description: IPC sharing mode for the service container. Use 'host' to share the host's IPC namespace, 'service:[service_name]' to share with another service, or 'shareable' to allow other services to share this service's IPC namespace.

isolation.description: Container isolation technology to use. Supported values are platform-specific.

labels.description: Add metadata to containers using Docker labels. You can use either an array or a list.

links.description: Link to containers in another service. Either specify both the service name and a link alias (SERVICE:ALIAS), or just the service name.

driver.description: Logging driver to use, such as 'json-file', 'syslog', 'journald', etc.

mem_limit.description: Memory limit for the container. A string value can use suffix like '2g' for 2 gigabytes.

mem_swappiness.description: Container memory swappiness as percentage (0 to 100).

memswap_limit.description: Amount of memory the container is allowed to swap to disk. Set to -1 to enable unlimited swap.

network_mode.description: Network mode. Values can be 'bridge', 'host', 'none', 'service:[service name]', or 'container:[container name]'.

endpoint_var.description: Environment variable set to AI model endpoint.

model_var.description: Environment variable set to AI model name.

models.description: AI Models to use, referencing entries under the top-level models key.

aliases.description: Alternative hostnames for this service on the network.

interface_name.description: Interface network name used to connect to network

ipv4_address.description: Specify a static IPv4 address for this service on this network.

ipv6_address.description: Specify a static IPv6 address for this service on this network.

mac_address.description: Specify a MAC address for this service on this network.

priority.description: Specify the priority for the network connection.

gw_priority.description: Specify the gateway priority for the network connection.

networks.description: Networks to join, referencing entries under the top-level networks key. Can be a list of network names or a mapping of network name to network configuration.

oom_kill_disable.description: Disable OOM Killer for the container.

oom_score_adj.description: Tune host's OOM preferences for the container (accepts -1000 to 1000).

pids_limit.description: Tune a container's PIDs limit. Set to -1 for unlimited PIDs.

platform.description: Target platform to run on, e.g., 'linux/amd64', 'linux/arm64', or 'windows/amd64'.

name.description: A human-readable name for this port mapping.

mode.description: The port binding mode, either 'host' for publishing a host port or 'ingress' for load balancing.

host_ip.description: The host IP to bind to.

app_protocol.description: Application protocol to use with the port (e.g., http, https, mysql).

post_start.description: Commands to run after the container starts. If any command fails, the container stops.

pre_stop.description: Commands to run before the container stops. If any command fails, the container stop is aborted.

privileged.description: Give extended privileges to the service container.

profiles.description: List of profiles for this service. When profiles are specified, services are only started when the profile is activated.

pull_policy.description: Policy for pulling images. Options include: 'always', 'never', 'if_not_present', 'missing', 'build', or time-based refresh policies.

pull_refresh_after.description: Time after which to refresh the image. Used with pull_policy=refresh.

read_only.description: Mount the container's filesystem as read only.

restart.description: Restart policy for the service container. Options include: 'no', 'always', 'on-failure', and 'unless-stopped'.

runtime.description: Runtime to use for this container, e.g., 'runc'.

scale.description: Number of containers to deploy for this service.

security_opt.description: Override the default labeling scheme for each container.

shm_size.description: Size of /dev/shm. A string value can use suffix like '2g' for 2 gigabytes.

secrets.description: Grant access to Secrets on a per-service basis.

sysctls.description: Kernel parameters to set in the container. You can use either an array or a list.

stdin_open.description: Keep STDIN open even if not attached.

stop_grace_period.description: Time to wait for the container to stop gracefully before sending SIGKILL (e.g., '1s', '1m30s').

storage_opt.description: Storage driver options for the container.

tmpfs.description: Mount a temporary filesystem (tmpfs) into the container. Can be a single value or a list.

tty.description: Allocate a pseudo-TTY to service container.

ulimits.description: Override the default ulimits for a container.

use_api_socket.description: Bind mount Docker API socket and required auth.

user.description: Username or UID to run the container process as.

uts.description: UTS namespace to use. 'host' shares the host's UTS namespace.

userns_mode.description: User namespace to use. 'host' shares the host's user namespace.

volumes.description: Mount host paths or named volumes accessible to the container. Short syntax (VOLUME:CONTAINER_PATH[:MODE])

type.description: The mount type: bind for mounting host directories, volume for named volumes, tmpfs for temporary filesystems, cluster for cluster volumes, npipe for named pipes, or image for mounting from an image.

source.description: The source of the mount, a path on the host for a bind mount, a docker image reference for an image mount, or the name of a volume defined in the top-level volumes key. Not applicable for a tmpfs mount.

target.description: The path in the container where the volume is mounted.

read_only.description: Flag to set the volume as read-only.

consistency.description: The consistency requirements for the mount. Available values are platform specific.

propagation.description: The propagation mode for the bind mount: 'shared', 'slave', 'private', 'rshared', 'rslave', or 'rprivate'.

create_host_path.description: Create the host path if it doesn't exist.

selinux.description: SELinux relabeling options: 'z' for shared content, 'Z' for private unshared content.

labels.description: Labels to apply to the volume.

nocopy.description: Flag to disable copying of data from a container when a volume is created.

subpath.description: Path within the volume to mount instead of the volume root.

size.description: Size of the tmpfs mount in bytes.

mode.description: File mode of the tmpfs in octal.

subpath.description: Path within the image to mount instead of the image root.

volumes_from.description: Mount volumes from another service or container. Optionally specify read-only access (ro) or read-write (rw).

working_dir.description: The working directory in which the entrypoint or command will be run
